optimizedDescription.value: Centralize graph CLI config/bootstrap/provider wiring via `@specd/sdk`; retain CLI signals, exits, formatted failures.

optimizedContext.value:
# Graph CLI Context
## Rules
- `resolveGraphCliContext`: configured mode via `resolveCliContext` / `openSpecdHost`; types only `@specd/sdk` re-exports.
- Configured (`--config` or discovered): use config project root; no VCS required; absent VCS root when undetected.
- Bootstrap (`--path` / no-config fallback): require VCS root; synthetic single-workspace project rooted there.
- `packages/cli/src/commands/graph/with-provider.ts` `withProvider`: build `SdkHostContext` from resolved config + kernel when available; lifecycle via `withOpenGraphProvider` from `@specd/sdk`.
- `withProvider` retains configured-command `SIGINT` / `SIGTERM`, post-close `process.exit(0)` for native graph-store threads, pre-open format-aware fatal reporting.
- `search`, `hotspots`, `impact`: module `withProvider`. `graph stats`: `openSpecdHost` + SDK lifecycle; never `resolveGraphCliContext` / pre-open lock probe.
- `graph index`: `runIndexProjectGraph` from `@specd/sdk`; no long-lived `withProvider`; worker indexes isolated.
- No host-managed pre-open lock probes; opened SDK lifecycle surfaces availability incl. indexing-busy.
## Constraints
- Host symbols: `@specd/sdk` via module or `cli:host-context`.
- SDK owns provider lifecycle; CLI owns bootstrap, signals, forced exit, error presentation.
